notes.title: Warmada released on Steam
notes.content:
Warmada is finally released on steam - thanks to all the supporters on steam greenlight and the early buyers on itch.io. Speaking of which, here are the patch notes for the release version of the game

1.0

Balanced upgrade system - NPC ships now have a smarter selection of upgrades relevant to the equipment they use
Autosaves now happen automatically, after certain fights are over or after decisions
Fixed crash with boarding craft and sending crew home
Fixed editor bugs where info was not being updated
New Ship Library visuals - now shows previews for ships, allows filtering of ships
Changed where ships are stored - user creations are saved in User, downloaded ships in Download and default ships in Default
If you want to be able to use your old designs, just put them in User
Updated ship death and warp effects
Updated weapon slots indicator in Ship Editor
Added a new faction with multiple ships
